page: Microsoft Azure E96-24ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the Eadv6 server family. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features an AMD processor with 24 dedicated vCPUs. The instance is configured with 672.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 28.0 GB per vCPU.

This server includes 5669 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput local read and write operations. It does not include any graphics processing units, making it a non-accelerated instance.

The E96-24ads_v6 represents a constrained-core configuration, which provides a massive memory footprint and large local storage capacity relative to the active CPU core count. This design is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require high memory and storage density but are licensed per core, allowing organizations to reduce software licensing costs while maintaining access to substantial memory and storage resources.

Due to its high memory-to-CPU ratio and large local NVMe SSD capacity, this server is suited for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. Appropriate use cases include large relational databases, in-memory caching systems, data warehousing, and enterprise applications requiring significant memory capacity alongside fast local temporary storage.
